_meta.purpose: Healthy-adult normative ml histogram windows for TotalSegmentator PRIMARY_SEGMENT_GROUPS latch names (controller/ai/tseg/config.py). Keys must match those group names exactly; there is no catch-all default.

sections.soft_organs: Major soft-tissue latch groups from the TS total task
sections.skeletal: Primary skeletal latch groups (skull, spine, clavicles, ribs)

_meta.notes: Spans are literature means with padding for sex/age/partial FOV; out-of-range samples still plot via axis extension. Not CT-task calibration data.
sources: Cressoni et al., Crit Care 2014;18:R104 (doi:10.1186/cc13875): supine CT total lung volume mean ~4995 ml (men ~5757, women ~4136).
Kawel-Boehm et al., J Cardiovasc Magn Reson 2020;22:87 (doi:10.1186/s12968-020-00683-3): adult CMR chamber volumes; whole-heart TS mask ≈ chambers + myocardium (~250–650 ml healthy).
DeSouza et al., Expert Rev Gastroenterol Hepatol 2018 (doi:10.1080/17474124.2018.1496015): adult pancreas volume typically ~71–83 ml (CT/MRI meta-analysis); CT ranges ~30–140 ml.
TS stomach is anatomical organ (wall ± lumen): empty-to-moderate fill typically tens–hundreds of ml; satiety MRI volumes can exceed 600 ml — axis padded accordingly.
Akeret et al., Brain Struct Funct 2021;226:1699-1711 (doi:10.1007/s00429-021-02280-1): encephalon / lobar / ventricle morphometry.
Potvin et al., NeuroImage 2016;137:9-20 (doi:10.1016/j.neuroimage.2016.05.016): FreeSurfer adult subcortical norms.
Bigler & Woodard skeletal mass fractions + ICRP reference bone density (~1.9 g/cm³): approximate healthy mineralized volumes for cranium, spine, ribs, clavicles (padded for TS mask FOV).
